feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 August 2026 8:11am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 20 August 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the North Sea moving away eastwards as high pressure in the Atlantic develops a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

North or northeast 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first, backing north or northwest this afternoon, decreasing 2 to 4 overnight and becoming variable 3 or less in eastern waters.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather##

Showers becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 2 to 4, but variable 3 or less in the east at first, then increasing 4 or 5 Friday evening. Decreasing 3 or 4 again later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the west later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers in the south at first, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers at first.
